Initial release of Free Video Generator Chinese AI.

- Automatic backend setup and authentication with free credits (no software needed).
- Supports multiple formats (mp4, mov, jpg, png, and more; up to 200MB).

- Smart prompt matching for actions like upload, export, credit check, and timeline status.
